name: rd_continual
label: RoboDojo, 42 tasks: one notebook of up to 120 KB learned continually, one task at a time, in one pass in a random order (seed-0 layout 5; a Generalization task runs both configs), checkpoint evals every 10 places (seed-1, 5 episodes per task)
embodiment: Every task of this benchmark runs on the same robot: the same two ARX X5 arms with their grippers, at the same table, with the same cameras and the same API. The tasks, their objects and their scenes differ.
